This was an invited webinar in the [ESA Statistical Ecology and Ecological Forecasting Initiative Statistical Methods Seminar Series](https://ecoforecast.org/workshops/statistical-methods-seminar-series/), given in May 2024. It was a joint presentation with [Jon Walter](../../../people.qmd#jonathan-walter). It gives a good introduction to some of the methods we commonly use to study synchrony.

The webinar includes worked examples and accompanying code. The recording and materials are here:

- [Recording on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sxVHFwAkhdA)
- [Worked examples and code on GitHub](https://github.com/reumandc/ReumanWalter_ESA_StatisticalMethodsWebinar)
- [The full seminar series, with links to other speakers' resources](https://ecoforecast.org/workshops/statistical-methods-seminar-series/#previous-resources)

People: [Jon Walter](../../../people.qmd#jonathan-walter), Dan Reuman
